description: Runs ServerScan's free one-off check of a payment or checkout page: TLS, security headers, the HTTP to HTTPS redirect, which scripts load and from where, and whether third-party scripts carry an integrity hash (PCI DSS 6.4.3 and 11.6.1). Returns six yes/no/not-yet-known answers and what to fix first. It fetches the page once. Any one site can be checked only a few times a day, and a repeat within 15 minutes returns the stored answer.

url.description: The payment page address, for example https://shop.example.com/checkout. A bare domain is read as https.

name: check_payment_page
title: Free payment page check
